stages.name: source_and_name_gates
checks: PDF pages 165-170 are one complete Carica papaya entry; PDF page 171 starts Sarothamnus scoparius.
Seven approved record sections are exact substrings of the cited pages.
番木瓜 is the display name, 木瓜 remains an alias, and naturalized occurrence metadata is separate from book facts.
The record explicitly guards against conflation with Chaenomeles sinensis.

stages.name: embedding_and_retrieval
checks: One Gemini Free Tier batch embedded six page baselines, sixteen 512/100 children and four queries.
Pure semantic and hybrid retrieval both ranked PDF page 168 first for Traditional Chinese and English Papayotin questions.
Chromosome and Chaenomeles wrong-name questions passed the exact book-evidence refusal gate.
Page baseline had a larger evidence margin in this sample, so 512/100 is retained for portable consistency rather than claimed universally superior.

stages.name: main_index_chat_and_gem
checks: The main index now has 28 approved children across 12 parent pages plus two preserved baselines.
All prior Podophyllum and Strychnos bilingual retrieval and refusal regressions remain valid.
The deterministic chat API passes 26 cases including bilingual Papayotin answers, medical refusal, unknown-fact refusal and wrong-name protection.
The Classic Gem evidence pack now exports four approved records.

stages.name: portable_n8n_harness
checks: The rebuild helper idempotently replays three explicitly approved bounded packages without model calls.
PEHybridIdx001 matches the canonical commands and remains inactive in n8n 2.12.3.
n8n and Qwen remain stopped; pre-import rollback artifacts are present.

warnings: The selected 512/100 profile did not beat page baseline evidence margin on this sample.
Historical medical passages remain non-prescriptive and must not expose doses or treatment advice.
Image reasoning and full-volume indexing remain disabled.
The next iteration is a cross-volume readiness review, not automatic production expansion.
